name: epdi-ai-gateway-dashboard
description: ORGA AI consumption dashboard. Built by the Docker node stage into /app/static and served by the gateway under /admin.
//: Versions are pinned exactly, not caret-ranged: this bundle is built inside the
container image, so a floating minor would make two builds of the same commit
produce different artefacts - which defeats the point of immutable ECR tags.
React 18 rather than 19 on purpose. recharts 2.x and @tanstack/react-table 8.x
are both long-proven against 18, and nothing here needs a React 19 feature.
Upgrading is a deliberate task with a test pass, not a default.
